title: Samsung Note 10+ Update
body: Does anyone have a fix for the Samsung Note 10+ Update which Samsung threw at me this afternoon please? My phone and Miaomiao transmitter will no longer speak to each other. It is the ui2.0 update. Prior to this everything  worked fine. Why oh why don't Samsung keep their big noses out of my life

comments.body: 10 hours of absolute torture (ok a bit over dramatic I will confess) and I have finally managed to get the phone, Xdrip and the Libre sensor all merrily talking to each other again. Several resets of everything, uninstalling and reinstalling Xdrip lots of times and have stumbled upon the fact that almost every Bluetooth option needs to be unchecked in the Xdrip Bluetooth menu with the exception of the very first one which is 'Turn Bluetooth on if switched off' The Miaomiao needs to be reset and the phone needs to reboot. The important thing seems though that rather than just doing a phone restart it actually needs completely shutting down and manually restarting. Nothing else or at least nothing I have been able to try works. This whole sorry episode again serves to highlight just how much I rely on Xdrip+ and I never ever tire of telling everyone what a complete game changer it has been for me. I can never thank you all enough for it
how is going with your solution? I'm having to update my note + and I really don't need the headache.

Hello, the solution seems to be working very well. I lost connection on Saturday when the battery died on my mobile phone. Reconnecting was an ordeal and it took several hours to establish a decent connection. I will say though that once connection is established the connection seems to be a lot more stable and I get far less missed Xdrip+ readings than before I did the software update on my phone. On a semi related matter I set a friend up on Tuesday evening with Xdrip+ and a Galaxy Note 10. He brought a Miaomiao 2 as he was unable to buy the first version. Connection was established immediately and I spoke with him about an hour ago and the connection he has appears to be extremely stable. I am unclear as to whether he has had an update on his phone OS. I will however ask him and report back. I think that I may end up buying a Miaomiao 2 myself.

[https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1236](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1236)

I took delivery of a Miaomiao V2 today. Charged it and removed the V1 from my Libre. Upon sticking the V2 to my Libre it pinged a result in under 10 seconds. It has continued to function without any hiccups ever since.

It is now 9 days since I replaced my Miaomiao V1 with my Miaomiao V2. I replaced a dead sensor on Sunday and in the whole 9 days since switching I have not had Xdrip+ report even 1 missed reading. I now have complete stability from Xdrip+, Miaomiao and Samsung Note 10. I never tire of extolling the many virtues of Xdrip+.I am sure all here will agree that for all of us it is an absolute game changer and I still cannot thank all involved in its creation and continued development my very sincere and very personal thanks.
I second that. Not the miaomiao v2 thing. I still have the v1 but I do thank everyone for making our shitty diabetic life a little better.
